method: Nagy 1966 rectangular prisms, near-zone only — not Complete Bouguer
numerical_approximation: Vectorized Nagy 1966 eight-term prism kernel per DEM cell inside the near-zone window.
convention: G-AID near-zone terrain-corrected Bouguer anomaly. Not a Complete Bouguer Anomaly. Not equivalent to a fully regional or commercial complete Bouguer product.
formula: Δg_NZTC = Δg_FA − 2πGρh [+ Bullard B if requested] + TC_Nagy(R or DEM extent). TC is |gz| of DEM−slab prisms (Nagy 1966) inside the near-zone window. Far-zone and intermediate-zone / Hayford–Bowie are not applied.
limitations: Terrain correction is limited to the configured DEM extent or radius.
Far-zone and intermediate-zone terrain effects are not included.
DEM cells outside the near-zone window are ignored.
No Earth curvature on the prism kernel itself (Bullard B is a separate optional term on the slab).
Not equivalent to Oasis montaj or any commercial Complete Bouguer product.
